text:
jen: heads up — support is getting multiple escalations: two large customers reporting 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference in us-west around 12:03 UTC. appears spike-y and correlated to renewal window traffic.

mike: looking at metrics now. p50->p95 token latency jumps at 12:02:30, gateway 502/504 bursts. backend traces show upstream auth proxy returning 502s. sample log: 
```
upstream_error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = upstream read timeout
route=/v1/generate host=hosted-us-west-01
```

anita: Any evidence of KV cache OOMs or batcher saturation? batcher CPU is high and queue depth spiking.

sre-bot: Alert: hosted-inference-gateway error_rate > 5% for /v1/generate (us-west) starting 1723459480

mike: repro from my laptop: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'` returns `502 Bad Gateway` intermittently and `504` after ~14s under concurrency.

jen: immediate mitigations: enable fallback-routing to smaller model variant + scale gateway pool + bump gateway timeout to 30s for affected routes. Can we flip fallback to small model now? :pray:

support-lead: customers are seeing timeouts and duplicate billing attempts. please coordinate with billing — may need to pause surge billing for affected tenants until root cause known. I'll prepare a customer-facing note.

anita: flipping fallback routing to small-variant canary at 3%. executing now.

anita: done — `route-config apply --env us-west --fallback small-v2 --percent 3` :white_check_mark:

mike: infra: spun +2 gateway instances and increased auth-proxy max connections to 10k. observing metrics.

jen: can we capture minimal repro steps for postmortem (exact commands, payload size, concurrency)? need to be able to reproduce reliably.

sam: repro I ran (local cluster): 20 concurrent requests, seq_len=2048 tokens, long prompts (~1500 tokens) -> 504s after ~14s. Steps:
1) for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long>"}' & done
2) watch gateway logs for `upstream read timeout`.

mike: correlation: KV cache eviction events at exact same timeframe, plus auth proxy logs show token refresh backpressure. saw `auth_refresh_rate_limit` warnings.

anita: propose action items (short-term):
- add autoscaler rule to pre-scale when inflight token count > 500
- increase auth proxy idle + upstream timeouts by 10s
- add prompt-length-based throttling guidance to docs and a runtime check
- postmortem and regression test with long-seq load tests

jen: assigning owners and ETA:
- mike -> autoscaler rule + logs correlation (ETA 6h)
- anita -> routing/fallback canary roll and rollback plan (ETA 1h)
- sam -> repro harness and publishing exact reproduce script (ETA 3h)
- support-lead -> customer comms + billing note (ETA 2h)
postmortem scheduled in 48h.

support-lead: I'll notify affected customers with interim mitigation and ETA. will coordinate with billing ops to mark any suspicious charges for review.

mike: uploading traces and heap dumps to s3: `s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1723459998/traces.tar.gz`

anita: after canary (3%) + scale up, error rate dropped from ~6.2% to ~0.6% within 8 minutes. increasing canary to 30% now.

jen: good. keep updates here if error rate climbs. when we close, include exact diffs for route-config + gateway and auth-proxy changes for the postmortem.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated — fallback routing + gateway scale applied. Please file postmortem with root cause hypothesis and RCA checklist.

jen: final action items for postmortem doc: include timeline, metric charts (p50/p95/p99), repro commands, config diffs, affected customer list, estimated billing impact, and mitigation timeline. I'll draft initial postmortem and circulate.
